title: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: GIFT Nifty signals a positive start; Asian shares trade lower - The Economic Times
text: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: The benchmark Nifty 50 fell 0.7% on Monday, while broader markets outperformed. Analysts expect Indian equities to remain cautious in the near term amid geopolitical tensions, volatile crude oil prices and uncertainty surrounding a resolution to the West Asia crisis. With the September-quarter earnings season gathering momentum, stock-specific action is likely to drive market movements.
